title: A smooth morphism is etale on an affine open where the differentials vanish
statement: Let $g:U\to S$ be a smooth morphism of schemes [def-sbc-smooth-morphisms]. Let $V\subseteq S$ and $W\subseteq U$ be affine open subschemes [def-weil-affine-spectrum] with $g(W)\subseteq V$, let $R=\mathcal O_S(V)$, $A=\mathcal O_U(W)$ and $R\to A$ the ring map corresponding to $g|_W:W\to V$, and assume that the module of Kähler differentials $\Omega_{A/R}$ [def-weil-pbc-kahler-differentials] is zero. Then the restriction $g|_W:W\to S$ is etale [def-weil-etale-morphism].
